The animal_pose_auditor flagged low-confidence keypoints in the joey's hind limbs and face, supporting my observation of fused forelimbs.

6. Atom Score Review: Each atom score was justified. For example, atom 2 (kangaroo presence) got 0.8 because while present, the yellow color and tail length deviations from taxonomy warranted a slight deduction from perfect 1.0. 

7. Upward Override Justification: I did not override any Router verdicts upward. All positive identifications (kangaroos, koala) were visually confirmed. The Router's negative verdicts (no pig, wrong count) were also visually verified. 

Final scores remain unchanged from initial assessment as they accurately reflect the image's strengths (koala rendering, prompt-following for color) and critical failures (missing pig, extra kangaroo, anatomical artifacts).
